title: Customer Reviews Technical Reference
readerIntent: Understand customer-review ownership, lifecycle, moderation, and integration.
priorKnowledge: Understand customer identity, products/content, workflows, and publishing.
summary: Customer reviews use owned schemas and services for submission, rating, moderation, publication, and integration; they do not write Product or customer identity records directly.

sections.heading: Contract
items: Tenant, customer/owner, subject type/reference, rating scale, title/body/media references, locale, status, timestamps, and version.
Eligibility, duplicate policy, verified relationship, moderation workflow, abuse/spam controls, masking, retention, and appeal.
Published aggregate projections remain derived; Product/content modules retain subject ownership.
Test unauthorized/cross-tenant, invalid rating, duplicate, moderation, publication, removal, aggregation, privacy, abuse, performance, and regression.
